questions.question: Analyze the challenges associated with assessing intangible, indirect and cumulative impacts of tourism. [15x1 = 15]
questions.solution_html:
• Analyse the challenges associated with assessing intangible, indirect and
  • cumulative impacts of tourism.
  • • Difficulty in measurement
  • • Subjective nature
  • • Lack of data
  • • Indirect effects: Tourism can influence other sectors through supply chains and
  • related activities.
  • • Cumulative impacts: Small individual impacts may combine and cause major
  • damage over time.
  • • Long-term effects
  • • Multiple stakeholders
  • • Attribution problems
  • • Changing conditions
  • • Limited resources
